quote:
When a thunderbolt of steel crashes into the earth, it reminds us that even the bravest of giants are not exempt from the wind's gentle inquiry.  

A single forbidden whisper can set the entire bamboo forest trembling, yet the river of economy keeps flowing unchanged.  

The silence after a major storm is the only place where the wind can truly hear itself apologise.  

In the court of history, a student's page can bleed more truth than the ruler's decree.  

When a widow of a captured general watches dawn, she sees that a nation's light can outshine the shadows of captivity.  

A royal child's misstep in the court of conscience can echo beyond the palace walls into the lives of ordinary walks.  

When a jazz maestro takes his final breath, the wind remembers the rhythm he once
